## Details
### **SW-REQ-SIM-SENS-001** — Synthetic Sensor Measurements from Truth State

- **Description:** The sim_sensors module shall generate synthetic IMU, barometer, and GPS measurements from the sim_dynamics truth state.
- **Rationale:** PM-required SITL sensor models feed the FSW POSIX driver layer in place of real hardware for closed-loop Trick simulation.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SENS-002** — Synthetic IMU Sample Rate

- **Description:** The sim_sensors module shall produce synthetic IMU measurements at 200 Hz.
- **Rationale:** PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-005 so FSW POSIX drivers consume sim IMU at the same rate as real IMU.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-005
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SENS-003** — Synthetic IMU Accelerometer Range Saturation

- **Description:** The sim_sensors module shall saturate synthetic accelerometer outputs at plus or minus 16 G.
- **Rationale:** PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-006 so sim IMU exhibits the same saturation behavior as the real accelerometer.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-006
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SENS-004** — Synthetic IMU Gyroscope Range Saturation

- **Description:** The sim_sensors module shall saturate synthetic gyroscope outputs at plus or minus 2000 degrees per second.
- **Rationale:** PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-007 so sim IMU exhibits the same saturation behavior as the real gyroscope.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-007
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SENS-005** — Synthetic IMU Quantization

- **Description:** The sim_sensors module shall quantize synthetic IMU measurements to 16-bit signed integers across the configured range.
- **Rationale:** PM-required ADC quantization match to real IMU so FSW driver layer observes identical resolution behavior.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1, sim

### **SW-REQ-SIM-SENS-006** — Configurable IMU Noise and Bias

- **Description:** The sim_sensors module shall apply configurable white noise and bias to synthetic IMU measurements.

- **Status:** Draft
